name: Amazon Nova Act
tagline: Build reliable AI agents that automate UI workflows in a browser.
description: An Amazon model and SDK for building agents that take actions in a web browser, breaking workflows into small, testable natural-language steps for reliability at scale. Developers script and chain browser actions in Python, and run them as production UI-automation agents. Available as an AWS service after a 2025 research preview.

modelSupport.notes: Built on Amazon's Nova Act action model; runs as an AWS service.

insight: Built by Amazon's SF AGI Lab from its 2024 Adept acqui-hire (led by David Luan); reached general availability at re:Invent 2025.
edge: Tuned for reliability — splits workflows into small natural-language steps, hitting ~90% success on UI tasks where general browser agents drift.
pros: Python SDK to script and chain browser actions
cons: Several founding Adept leads have since left

references.title: Amazon unveils Nova Act, an AI agent that can control a web browser
Head of Amazon's AGI lab is leaving in latest exit from Adept deal
